title: Wet Chemistry and Peptide Immobilization on Polytetrafluoroethylene for Improved Cell-adhesion
protocol: Work in a well-ventilated fume hood for all reactions involving flammable solvents and corrosive metals like metallic sodium.
Cut 0.25 g of sodium metal into small pieces.
Add the cut sodium to a solution of 1.4 g of naphthalene in 20 ml of THF (dried over molecular sieve) in a screw-capped glass bottle with a PTFE-coated magnetic stirring bar.
Heat the mixture to 35 - 40 °C if necessary to enhance dissolution.
Mix the solution until it turns dark and slightly greenish, indicating complete reaction.
Store the final sodium naphthalenide solution under strictly dry conditions.
Punch out 12 mm diameter PTFE discs from 0.5 mm thick foil material.
Mark one side of each PTFE disc using a letter stamp punch.
Clean PTFE discs with isopropanol.
Incubate individual PTFE discs in the activating solution for 1 - 2 minutes using forceps.
Observe color change from white to dark brown on PTFE discs, indicating successful treatment.
Rinse samples twice with THF and then with iso-propanol.
Oxidize treated samples in hydrogen peroxide (30%) containing 20% (w/v) trichloroacetic acid for 3 hr.
Wash oxidized samples with water and dry.
Treat oxidized discs with 50% (v/v) hexamethylene diisocyanate (HMDI) in dry THF for 2 hr.
Rinse treated samples with THF and leave to dry.
Hydrolyze isocyanate-bearing samples in water for 2 - 3 hr and dry.
Prepare a solution of 20% (v/v) diethyleneglycol diglycidyl ether (diepoxide) in 50 mM carbonate buffer, pH 9.
Place the aminated discs with the marked side up individually into a 24 well plate.
Add 1.5 ml of epoxide solution to ensure full coverage of the samples.
Incubate for 2 hr and wash two times with water.
Wash once with carbonate buffer.
Add 50 µl of a 0.5 mg/ml peptide in 50 mM carbonate buffer, pH 9 containing 0.01% NaN3 to the bottom of individual wells in a fresh 24 well plate.
Place epoxy-functionalized discs upside-down onto the drop of peptide solution.
Incubate in a wet chamber with humidified atmosphere for at least 3 hr or overnight.
Wash three times with water.
Sterilize in 50% iso-propanol/water for at least 30 min.
Rinse samples in sterile phosphate buffered saline (PBS) prior to cell seeding.
Grow HUVECs using standard cell culture procedures.
Place peptide-conjugated samples with the modified side up in a 24 well plate.
Seed 5 x 10^4 HUVECs in 2 ml medium per well and incubate for 4 hr at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Remove discs, rinse carefully to remove unattached cells, and transfer to a fresh 24 well plate.
Add 2 ml of fresh medium and incubate for the desired period (e.g., 24 hr, 1 w).
Change medium every two days.
Prepare a stock solution of 1 mg/ml Calcein-AM in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO).
Remove the medium from the cells.
Wash the cells with PBS.
Add PBS containing 1 µl/ml Calcein-AM stain to the cells.
Gently agitate the cell suspension.
Incubate at 37 °C for 45 min in the dark.
Wash the cells with PBS.
Take micrographs on a fluorescence microscope equipped with standard FITC filters (Ex 488 nm, Em 515 nm) using 100-fold magnification.
Perform triplicates from unmodified as well as treated samples.
Using ImageJ software, determine the area colonized by the cells.
